hooks.text: The 2025 dire wolf pups were actually gray wolves with twenty edits.
Did scientists really bring back the extinct dire wolf?
The new dire wolf pups never received a single drop of ancient DNA.

title: The Truth Behind the 2025 Dire Wolf Pups
description: Colossal Biosciences announced genetically modified gray wolf pups meant to mimic the extinct dire wolf, but independent experts argue they are hybrid gray wolves.

beats.text: The 2025 dire wolf pups were actually gray wolves with twenty edits.
beats.visual: Gray wolf portrait in Yellowstone National Park, 2025

beats.text: Most people believe scientists successfully resurrected the Ice Age predator using ancient DNA.
beats.visual: Pleistocene megafauna illustration of dire wolves

beats.text: The dire wolf species vanished approximately ten thousand to thirteen thousand years ago.
beats.visual: Dire wolf fossil jaw specimen in museum display

beats.text: Instead of splicing ancient genetic material, researchers rewrote existing cells from modern gray wolves.
beats.visual: Cell culture microscope laboratory setting with scientist

beats.text: Biologists made twenty targeted edits across fourteen genes to mimic traits like a wider head.
beats.visual: Genetics laboratory equipment and DNA sequencing screen

beats.text: The modified embryos were implanted into surrogate domestic dogs and delivered via cesarean section.
beats.visual: Hound mix dog in veterinary clinic setting

beats.text: Independent experts and the IUCN argue these animals are simply hybrid gray wolves.
beats.visual: Gray wolf standing in snowy forest reserve
